$description: Project Ambrose by Imjustchico: the only exceptions the front-end checks allow. A line here is an exception a reviewer can see, since the repository carries no comments to hold one.

lines.reason: A dialog keeps a 1rem gutter on each side of a narrow screen; the width is the viewport less two spacing steps, which no single size step expresses.
The collapsed sidebar is its icon width token plus one spacing step, computed from both tokens.
The floating and inset collapsed sidebar adds its two border pixels to the same computed width.
The switch thumb travels its own width less its two-pixel inset, which depends on the thumb's size, not on a scale step.
A tab is one pixel shorter than its list so the list's border shows beneath it.
The tooltip's arrow sits half its own height plus two pixels outside the bubble, a position computed from its size.
The console fills about half the viewport's height whatever the screen; no size step is a share of the viewport.
The log list fills most of the viewport's height whatever the screen; no size step is a share of the viewport.

reasons.http://www.w3.org/: The XML namespace an inline SVG declares. Nothing is fetched from it.
reasons.https://www.w3.org/: The same namespace in its secure spelling.
reasons.https://svelte.dev/e/: The address Svelte prints beside a runtime error. It is a string in a message, never a request.
reasons.https://tailwindcss.com: The address the styling engine prints beside its own error text, for the same reason.
